mapper.select:
select * from sys_menu where `delete` = 0 and menu_name like concat('%',#{permKey},'%') and perm_key like concat('%',#{permKey},'%')
and status =#{status}
AND date_format(u.create_time,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
AND date_format(u.create_time,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{endTime},'%Y%m%d')
mapper.insert: insert into sys_menu(menu_name, perm_key, parent_id, menu_type, route, backlinks, path, icon, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{menuName}, #{permKey}, #{parentId}, #{menuType}, #{route}, #{backlinks}, #{path}, #{icon}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.update: update sys_menu set menu_name = #{menuName}, perm_key = #{permKey}, parent_id=#{parentId}, menu_type = #{menuType}, route=#{route}, backlinks = #{backlinks}, path= #{path}, icon=#{icon}, status=#{status}, update_by = #{updateBy} where menu_id =#{menuId}
update sys_menu set status = #{status} where menu_id = #{menuId}
